newsitem.title: CHINA: World Bank to lend China $2.5-3 bln a year to 2000.
newsitem.headline: World Bank to lend China $2.5-3 bln a year to 2000.

text.p: The World Bank will lend China $2.5-3.0 billion annually for the next three fiscal years to help fund projects in areas such as infrastructure development and poverty relief, the China Daily newspaper said on Saturday.
The bank's board of directors had approved the loans, the first of which would be made this month, the newspaper quoted bank officials in China as saying.
The loans would be used for infrastructure development, poverty relief, environmental protection and human resources development, the newspaper said.
The World Bank had loaned China $2.8 billion for 11 projects in the fiscal year ended June 30, it said but gave no further details.
